name: PokeFields
summary:
PokeFields is a brand new Pokemon MMORPG designed around both new and old fans of the Pokemon franchise. Starting in the Iconic Kanto region packed with new areas and a custom storyline, this gives a fresh perspective to give players a new experience.
Here, players have access to an influx of Pokemon not normally found in Kanto, as well as Mining, Foraging and Tree Cutting. These resources can be used to aid in your quest to conquer the Kanto region 12 years after Red.
